series_computation.framing: Repeated-source series: one source (Deathbringer Stance), one healer and healed unit (enemy:Aatrox), seven successive rows on trigger_target 'main'. Posed and computed whole, member by member, per the R-15/R-18 amendment, because a single applied_amount handed over alone is the underdetermined triple (amount, applied_amount, overheal) that produced the C2 dissent on sibling record [39].

independent_cross_checks: Mirror series onto ally:Lulu: Lulu 565 + 92*17 = 2129 max health, MR 30 + 1.3*17 = 52.1 -> 52; 0.10*2129 = 212.9; 212.9*100/152 = 140.065789; x2 = 280.131579 -> 280.1, exactly the committed mirror amount 280.1.

Umbral Dash (Aatrox E passive): "Passive: Aatrox heals for 16% (+ 1.1% per 100 bonus health) of non-persistent post-mitigation damage he deals against enemy champions." Aatrox holds no items so bonus health = 0 -> 16%, doubled by World Ender -> 32%. 0.32 * 179.700599 = 57.504 -> 57.5, exactly the committed unmoved sibling rows [23] and [33] (main). 0.32 * 140.065789 = 44.821 -> 44.8, exactly the committed unmoved sibling rows [22] and [32] (ally:Lulu).
Four independent committed sibling values therefore confirm both the mechanic and the x2.00 World Ender amplifier; the amount half of the triple is not merely asserted unmoved, it is derived.

step_3_clipping_identity.identity: applied_amount = min(amount, room), overheal = amount - applied_amount, hence applied_amount + overheal = amount, with room = H0 - current_health
step_3_clipping_identity.source: docs/math-foundations.md Section 5, clip row: "clipping identity absorbed = min(shield, damage), overkill = max(0, damage-absorbed); absorbed+overkill = damage" - EXACT. Every member carries healing_reduction_factor 1.0 and temporary_health 0.0, and no Grievous Wounds or healing reduction appears anywhere in the snapshot, so raw_amount = reduced_amount = amount = 359.4 and the identity applies unattenuated.
step_3_clipping_identity.conclusion: The identity holds on all seven pre-change members without exception, so it is the engine's own invariant for this series and not an assumption imported by the adjudicator.

step_4_room_path_of_the_whole_series.structure: Every member except [47] carries a strictly positive overheal, which means every one of them tops the healed unit back to exactly H0 = 2588. The room therefore resets to zero at each member, and the members are coupled only through the damage taken in the intervening window - no error propagates from one member into the next. This is why each leaf can independently carry its own certified overheal without contradicting its neighbours, and it is consistent with the committed survival record: ending_health 2588.0, ending_health_ratio 1.0, death_time null.

step_4_room_path_of_the_whole_series.downstream_coherence: The new leaf still carries overheal 22.2 > 0, so it still tops the healed unit to exactly 2588 at t=2.16. Member 4 at t=3.23 therefore still measures its room from full, the unmoved sibling rows at t=3.23 keep their committed splits, and survival.ending_health stays 2588.0 with death_time null. Bounds: 0 <= 337.2 <= amount 359.4, and total room at the batch top 782.8 <= H0 2588.

step_5_forced_value.given: amount = 359.4 (committed unmoved AND independently derived in step 2); overheal = 22.2 (certified new_value_correct by oracle-P4B-leaf26.json under the 2026-08-14 R-18 certified-fact amendment)
step_5_forced_value.refutation_of_old_value: 322.0 + 22.2 = 344.2 != 359.4. Holding the old applied half against the certified overheal half would destroy 15.2 of a heal whose amount is committed unmoved and derived from the wiki at 359.401198 -> 359.4. The old value is only self-consistent with the superseded overheal 37.4, which is exactly the half the certified receipt overturns.
step_5_forced_value.refutation_of_both_wrong: both_wrong would require either the amount to have moved or the certified overheal to be wrong. The amount is reproduced from scratch at 359.401198 from data/champions.json and data/items.json and is corroborated by four unmoved sibling values (280.1, 57.5, 44.8 twice each); the overheal is a certified fact of the record. Neither escape is available, so the triple is fully determined.

verdict_reasoning: amount is unmoved at 359.4 and independently derived (300.1 raw magic = 10% of Jax's 3001 max health, mitigated at 100/167 = 179.700599, doubled by World Ender rank 3 = 359.401198). The clipping identity applied_amount + overheal = amount holds on all seven members of the series. The sibling overheal is certified at 22.2. Therefore applied_amount = 359.4 - 22.2 = 337.2 = new_value, and the old value 322.0 is arithmetically impossible against the certified half.
